pack.name: Clonedivers Forge
pack.notes: Clonedivers r21 (v2.1): 31-UNIT Republic AT-TE/LAAT/Venator/TX-130/SEAF/Fixer/CW-4 GPU-skinning & culling overhaul, ITU-R BS.1770-4 (-18.0 LUFS) leveled Delta Squad & Clone Trooper voices + sealed 103 Armory previews, 10-draw Republic Clone LEGO minifigure breakup gibs, cleaned 570 US armor/helmet/blaster strings with '(Replaces ...)' descriptions, 3-way Bot & 3-way Squid (Mixed Covenant + Squids) selectors, and 5 performance tiers down to 256px + decimated meshes.
pack.statusNotes: Verified across all 5 tiers (full, lighter, reduced1024, reduced512, potato256) with 0 duplicate keys, 0 missing dependencies, 0 codec mismatches, and 139/139 runtime pins preserved.

textureProfiles.name: Full (Ultra)
textureProfiles.description: Original full-mip texture detail and full-resolution meshes.

textureProfiles.name: Balanced (Streamed)
textureProfiles.description: Full texture detail streamed on demand (-StreamFloor 512) to cut resident VRAM.

textureProfiles.name: 512px (Low / Deck)
textureProfiles.description: 512px texture cap (-StreamFloor 128) for low-VRAM GPUs and handhelds.

textureProfiles.name: 256px + Decimated Meshes (Ultra-Potato)
textureProfiles.description: 256px texture cap (-StreamFloor 64) plus vertex-compacted meshes preserving all 139 runtime-pinned LEGO/Yoda/TIE assets.
